Revenue 742,318; Cost of sales 71,573; Gross Profit 670,745; Interest income 3,457,559; Other income 82,694; Net Operating income 4,210,998; Credit loss expense 20,619 plus Personnel 968,451 plus Other operating 753,400 plus Depreciation 33,610 plus Amortisation 27,490 gives total operating expenses 1,803,570; Profit before finance costs and tax 2,407,428; Finance costs nil; Profit before income tax 2,407,428; Income tax 818,526; Profit after tax 1,588,902. Ties: 4,210,998 less 1,803,570 equals 2,407,428, and 2,407,428 less 818,526 equals 1,588,902. The audit rule requires the cell to equal the discovery record's profit_after_tax with the unit applied (absolute 1588902000); per fix-only-by-withholding it was nulled rather than rescaled.
